mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is fixed as positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting monetary policy easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise in the same month or Rank IC < 0.03 for the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 90), a monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals recovery in supply capacity, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO rises in a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 90) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over 3 months signals rising inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp in 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a growth slowdown regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 1%), a positive GDP surprise (GDPC1 above prior quarter level) signals economic resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 1% and current GDPC1 > prior quarter or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in current month or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises in high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
